FortiADC-KVM # config system schedule-group
  edit "netops-173-sg-now"
    config  schedule-member
      edit "1"
        set type weekly-recurring
        set starttime-of-startdate 00:00
        set endtime-of-enddate 23:59
        set day-of-week saturday
      next
    end
  next
  edit "netops-173-sg-off"
    config  schedule-member
      edit "1"
        set type weekly-recurring
        set starttime-of-startdate 00:00
        set endtime-of-enddate 23:59
        set day-of-week wednesday
      next
    end
  next
end

FortiADC-KVM #
